units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 52a:16">Ab. Zar. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ כלי לע״ז</he> if one welds a (broken) vessel for idolatrous purposes, contrad. to <he>עשה</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 16b:2">Sabb. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שברתן … ורִיתְּכָן וכ׳</he> she broke them (the silver vessels) and gave them to a silversmith, who welded and made them into new vessels.
